title: nan
authors: Golan D.; Kennedy P.; Gonzalez B.; Taylor R.; Perry J.; Thomas E.; Ebrahimi R.; Fox K.; Drakunov S.
key_contribution: Presents a swarm UAV system (SUAVE) for area mapping in GPS-denied locations using SLAM with LiDAR, camera, and IMU localization, demonstrated via fused multi-UAV autonomous test flights.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
